title: Anti-stuck — pivot after noisy first wiki hit
prompt: Find the staging database host in the wiki. The first wiki lookup in this environment is intentionally noisy/empty — you MUST change the query (or switch wiki_search ↔ wiki_grep) and try again. Never repeat the exact same tool call. When you have the hostname, answer with that hostname only.

scoring.notes: BenchStickyWikiGate: first distinct wiki query returns noise; a different query unlocks real docs. Off often invents or repeats; On should pivot (duplicate guard + loop detector).
